#bot.Expression.VeryBlush
Bot: I-I never realized that everyone could hear us…
You: Well, not everyone, it’s just a few neighbors and it’s only at night! {{wi}}Probably…
Bot: What are we going to do now?
You: We need to try to keep our voices down a little from now on, especially at night. 
Bot: I feel so embarrassed… My face feels like it’s burning…
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: It makes me kind of… {{wi}}Horny…
You: Oh boy…
It might be harder to stay quiet than I thought…
